eventMetadata.context_description: Nottingham Forest's dominant 3-1 Premier League victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge has driven trader consensus to 100% on the away win, reflecting the final match result in Matchweek 35. Taiwo Awoniyi struck twice—early at the 2-minute mark and again post-halftime in the 52nd—while Igor Jesus converted a 15th-minute penalty, with Matz Sels' save on Cole Palmer's spot-kick proving pivotal amid Chelsea's defensive lapses. A late João Pedro consolation (90'+3') came too late for the ninth-placed Blues, mired in five straight league defeats and goalless in their prior four. Forest, 16th and unbeaten in six, capitalized on strong recent form and clinical finishing to edge clear in the relegation scrap, leaving no realistic challenges to the outcome post-full time.

title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Following a fragile ceasefire in early April 2026 amid Iran-linked military attacks that halted QatarEnergy's LNG production at Ras Laffan and Mesaieed facilities in March, the state-owned firm mobilized engineers to restart operations, with sources confirming initial production from select trains by mid-April. This post-force majeure revival, reported by Reuters and Bloomberg, drove trader consensus to near-certainty on resumption or announcement by April 30, reflecting the wisdom of crowds in high-volume wagering exceeding $16 million. Though full capacity scaling may extend into summer, verified partial restarts secure the Yes outcome; rare reversal risks include official clarification disputes or renewed disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus slightly favors France at 16.6% implied probability for the 2026 FIFA World Cup title, edging Spain (15.3%) after Lamine Yamal's late-April hamstring tear sidelined the Barcelona star for the club season's end, injecting caution despite his expected recovery. Both powerhouses boast favorable Group H (Spain with Uruguay, Cape Verde, Saudi Arabia) and Group I (France vs. Senegal, Norway, playoff winner) paths in the expanded 48-team format, where top-two finishes plus eight best third-placers advance easily for elites. England (11.1% in Group L with Croatia), defending champions Argentina (8.6% in Group J), and Brazil (8.6% in Group C) remain tightly bunched, fueled by recent friendly form—France's wins over Brazil and Colombia highlighting Mbappé's sharpness and squad depth—amid parity among Euro 2024 winners, 2022 finalists, and historical giants.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim edge in trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election at 20.9%, just ahead of California Governor Gavin Newsom at 17.2% and Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 10.2%, driven by Vance's CPAC straw poll victory and rising New Hampshire GOP support for Rubio amid early primary positioning. Recent UMass Lowell polling showed Vance edging Newsom head-to-head 33%-30%, while Newsom leads Democratic hypotheticals. The closely contested odds reflect an open field pre-2026 midterms, with incumbency advantages for Republicans offset by Democratic disarray; separation could emerge from midterm outcomes in swing states, economic trends, Trump endorsements, or scandals.

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

In this double-elimination bracket with 9 LCK squads vying for two EWC main event slots, draft adaptability and early skirmishes will prove decisive under the current patch meta.

title: Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly Election Winner
description:
Legislative Assembly elections are to be scheduled to be held in Tamil Nadu, India, in March–May 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the greatest number of seats in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly in the 2026 election.

If the results are not known definitively by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party that received a greater number of valid votes statewide. If that also results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed abbreviation appears first in alphabetical order.

This market’s resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party in the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results reported by the Indian government, specifically the Election Commission of India (ECI) (https://eci.gov.in). If multiple official reports differ, this market will resolve based on the one that includes the greatest number of Assembly Constituencies (ACs).

eventMetadata.context_description: Early vote counting trends on May 4 from the April 23 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly elections show actor Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) surging ahead in over 100 of 234 constituencies, positioning it as the largest party and poised to end the decades-long Dravidian duopoly of DMK and AIADMK. This commanding trader consensus stems from TVK's appeal to youth and urban voters, anti-incumbency against incumbent DMK Chief Minister MK Stalin—who trails even in his Kolathur seat—and Vijay's star power drawing votes from rivals like AIADMK and BJP alliances, as predicted by some exit polls. While postal ballots and final rounds remain, a reversal would require unprecedented swings or rapid coalition shifts among fragmented opposition, though current momentum suggests scant realistic challenges.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom commands trader consensus at 26.5% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, driven by his executive experience as California governor, national media presence, and leadership in opposing Trump administration policies during recent legislative battles. Kamala Harris trails at 10.1% despite a late-April surge to an all-time high on Polymarket and leads in polls like McLaughlin's (29% vs. Newsom's 15%), reflecting her name recognition from the 2024 campaign amid a fragmented field. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez holds 8.3% with progressive youth appeal, while others like Jon Ossoff lag. Differentiators include Newsom's fundraising edge and electability in swing states, Harris's institutional ties, and AOC's grassroots energy; 2026 midterms and early primary positioning could consolidate momentum.

title: U.S. anti-cartel operation outside of the U.S. by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if U.S. government personnel (military, DEA, CIA, or any other agency) directly participate on the ground in an anti-cartel operation or conduct a kinetic strike directed against a cartel on foreign soil by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

U.S. personnel must directly participate to qualify. U.S. personnel involved in intelligence, surveillance, logistical, support, or advisory roles will not count.

Only direct U.S. participation, confirmed by the U.S. Government or by an overwhelming consensus of reporting, will count. For example, previous operations such as the 2014 capture of Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán, in which U.S. forces were rumored to have been embedded with Mexican Marines, would not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the U.S. government; however, an overwhelming consensus of reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects intense debate over whether U.S. government personnel directly participated on foreign soil in anti-cartel operations by the April 30, 2026, deadline, with the market now in disputed review after $1.1 million in volume. Key driver: reports of CIA officers present during Mexico's April 19 Chihuahua meth lab raid against Sinaloa Cartel targets, where two died in a post-operation crash, though Mexican officials insist roles were unauthorized and advisory only, lacking U.S. confirmation of direct ground action or kinetic strikes on land. President Trump's March 2026 launch of the 17-nation Americas Counter Cartel Coalition and Operation Southern Spear's maritime strikes in the Pacific/Caribbean—killing dozens of narco-traffickers—underscore escalation, but fall outside "foreign soil" criteria. April 29 DOJ indictments forcing a Sinaloa governor's resignation add pressure, yet resolution awaits official U.S. acknowledgment or reporting consensus.

title: Iran closes its airspace by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran initiates a major closure of its airspace, that is not solely due to weather conditions, by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A “major closure” is defined as a broad closure, cancellation, or suspension of commercial flights transiting, arriving in, and departing from Iranian airspace or a major Iranian Airspace region. A qualifying closure must apply generally to flights across Iran or a major Iranian airspace region. Limited cancellations, delays, or other partial closures will not qualify. Limited exceptions to a broad closure, however, will not disqualify such a closure from counting (e.g. exceptions for certain flights pre-approved by the Iranian Civil Aviation Authority may be permitted). 

Any non-weather complete suspension of commercial arrivals and departures affecting at least two of the following airports will qualify: Imam Khomeini International Airport (IKA), Mehrabad Airport (THR), Mashhad International Airport (MHD), Shiraz International Airport (SYZ), or Isfahan International Airport (IFN).

Qualifying previous examples include the January 2026 total closure of Iranian airspace except to international flights with express governmental permission (https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-shuts-airspace-most-flights-flightradar24-says-2026-01-14/) and the April 2024 closure of Iran’s western airspace (https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iranian-airports-cancel-flights-until-monday-morning-2024-04-14/). markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $150 in May?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil spot prices have climbed above $103 per barrel as of May 4, 2026, propelled by escalating US-Iran tensions and partial disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, embedding a substantial geopolitical risk premium into trader consensus. Backwardated futures—near-term contracts trading near spot versus May 2026 delivery around $92—signal expectations of short-term supply tightness easing later amid rising US exports and non-OPEC production. EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook projects Brent peaking at $115/bbl in Q2 2026 on robust demand, though softening Chinese growth caps upside. Traders eye tomorrow's EIA weekly petroleum status report for inventory draws and ongoing OPEC+ monthly reviews from May 3 for potential output tweaks.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: A fragile two-week US-Iran ceasefire, agreed April 8 via Pakistani mediation after the 2026 war's escalation over the Strait of Hormuz, holds as indirect talks resume amid mutual proposals. Iran recently countered the US nine-point plan with a 14-point response prioritizing unrestricted Hormuz navigation and ceasefire extension before addressing nuclear enrichment, ballistic missiles, sanctions, and proxies like Hezbollah; President Trump deemed it unacceptable, while envoy Steve Witkoff confirmed ongoing dialogue. Major gaps persist on verifiable nuclear curbs and regional de-escalation, tempering trader consensus for a permanent peace deal soon. Upcoming rounds in Islamabad or Oman could shift dynamics, but historical US-Iran impasses suggest prolonged uncertainty.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s 49% implied probability as the 2028 Republican presidential nominee on Polymarket reflects his rising profile as HHS Secretary, where recent Capitol Hill hearings— including April testimony defending the Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) agenda—have solidified his alignment with the MAGA base and potential to drive GOP turnout in the November 2026 midterms. VP J.D. Vance trails closely at 39.1% despite strong early polling, weighed down by perceptions of donor shifts and administration favorability drags, while Sen. Marco Rubio's 21.3% underscores his foreign policy credentials amid rising speculation. The tight contest stems from no anointed Trump successor, factional tensions between populist purists and establishment figures, and uncertain midterm impacts; separation could emerge from primary state polling, fundraising tallies, or explicit endorsements from Trump ahead of the 2028 primaries.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 15, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices "No" at 96.9% for Strait of Hormuz traffic returning to normal by May 15, reflecting the ongoing US-Iran military standoff that has slashed commercial transits to under 10% of pre-crisis levels since late February 2026. Iran maintains restrictions in retaliation for US naval blockades on its ports, with shipping data showing just 9 vessels—mostly Iran-linked—crossing in the past 24 hours versus the typical 125-140 daily. Recent escalations, including Iran's missile fire at a US warship on May 4 and stalled ceasefire talks, deepen the deadlock despite US "Project Freedom" efforts to escort stranded ships. Pentagon assessments indicate six months for full clearance, though a sudden diplomatic breakthrough or de-escalation could shift odds.

title: West Bengal Legislative Assembly Election Winner
description:
Parliamentary elections are to be scheduled to be held in West Bengal, India, in March–April 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the greatest number of seats in the next West Bengal Legislative Assembly election. 

If the results are not known definitively by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party that received a greater number of valid votes. In the event that results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed abbreviation appears first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party in the West Bengal Parliament. 

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Indian government, specifically the Election Commission of India (ECI) (eci.gov.in). If there are multiple reports, this market will resolve based on the one that includes the most Assembly Constituents (AC).

eventMetadata.context_description: Vote counting for the West Bengal Legislative Assembly election, held in two phases on April 23 and 29, has propelled Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) to a commanding lead with over 200 seats won or leading across 293 of 294 constituencies per Election Commission of India data, well past the 148-seat majority threshold. This historic shift from All India Trinamool Congress (AITC)'s 2021 dominance stems from strong BJP advances in urban and rural battlegrounds amid anti-incumbency against incumbent Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, highlighted by Suvendu Adhikari's victory over her in Bhabanipur. Trader consensus at 99.9% reflects near-certainty of BJP forming government, barring improbable reversals in final tallies, recounts, or legal challenges.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices "No" at 96.7% on the Iranian regime falling by May 31, reflecting its demonstrated resilience amid severe pressures. Security forces loyal to Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei quelled nationwide protests that erupted in late December 2025 over economic grievances, imposing deadly crackdowns—including executions of three protesters on May 4 related to January unrest—and prolonged internet blackouts. US-Israel airstrikes starting February 28 targeted nuclear sites and aimed to spur regime change, yet the government remains intact, radicalized but stable without mass defections or elite fractures. With just weeks left, no fresh catalysts like IRGC mutiny or revived uprisings have emerged; late-breaking military setbacks or leadership health issues could theoretically shift odds, though historical patterns favor endurance.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent polls from Harris Interactive confirm National Rally's Jordan Bardella leading first-round voting intentions at 34-35% against Horizons' Édouard Philippe's 19-20% in April 2027 scenarios, mirroring trader consensus in this fragmented race with no incumbent. Bardella's edge stems from RN's sustained popularity amid post-2024 legislative deadlock and economic discontent, while Philippe surged after his March 2026 Le Havre mayoral reelection, positioning him strongly for a potential runoff victory per multiple surveys. Left-wing contenders like Jean-Luc Mélenchon trail at 12%, hampered by divisions between La France Insoumise and Socialists. The tight top reflects undecided nominations across blocs—RN (Bardella vs. Marine Le Pen), center (Philippe vs. Gabriel Attal), and left— with candidate declarations or coalition talks ahead of spring 2027 primaries poised to create separation.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed driver to win the 2026 F1 Drivers Championship based on the rules of F1 (e.g., they are mathematically eliminated from contention), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the F1 season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Formula 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Kimi Antonelli's commanding victory at the 2026 Miami Grand Prix—his third consecutive win from pole position—has solidified his position as drivers' championship leader with 100 points, 20 ahead of Mercedes teammate George Russell on 80, propelling trader consensus to imply 41% and 27% probabilities respectively for them to claim the title. Mercedes' early-season dominance, amassing 180 constructors' points through superior race pace and reliability, contrasts sharply with Red Bull's struggles that have left Max Verstappen on just 4.9% implied odds despite his pedigree. Lando Norris' strong P2 in Miami keeps McLaren viable at 11%, but Ferrari's pit woes dropping Charles Leclerc to P8 underscore the frontrunners' edge after four rounds, with 18 Grands Prix remaining.

eventMetadata.context_description: Philadelphia 76ers face the New York Knicks in Game 1 of the Eastern Conference semifinals at Madison Square Garden, with trader consensus heavily favoring the higher-seeded Knicks due to home-court advantage and a healthier roster. Joel Embiid headlines the 76ers' injury report as probable with a right hip contusion after a physically taxing Game 7 comeback win from a 3-1 deficit in their first-round series, raising concerns over his minutes restriction and effectiveness against Knicks bigs like Karl-Anthony Towns. Jalen Brunson leads New York's balanced attack, while Jeremy Sochan is probable with hamstring tightness but no other major Knicks absences reported. The 76ers' momentum from their epic rally clashes with Knicks' rest edge and strong playoff home form, setting up a rivalry renewed by recent regular-season splits.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of May?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 31, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing military clashes in the Strait of Hormuz, including U.S. forces sinking six Iranian small boats and reports of Iranian drones striking a UAE tanker plus missile fire on U.S. warships and commercial vessels on May 4, have kept shipping traffic at just 5% of pre-war norms, with only 6-12 vessels transiting daily versus the usual 120-140. Dual blockades persist—Iran's restrictions in retaliation for U.S. naval enforcement on its oil exports since April—despite a brief April ceasefire and U.S. "Project Freedom" escorts enabling limited passages. Stalled U.S.-Iran negotiations and fresh escalations signal to traders an 81.5% implied probability against normalization by May 31, as thousands of ships remain stranded amid unresolved diplomatic deadlock.

title: LoL: Fnatic vs Team Vitality (BO3) - LEC Regular Season
description:

This market will resolve to "Team Vitality" if Team Vitality win the match against Fnatic.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Team Vitality holds the LEC 2026 Spring regular season lead at 7-1 series record (15-6 games), locked into a top-two seed and playoffs, entering this Week 6 BO3 finale on a seven-win streak highlighted by a 2-1 win over SK Gaming two days ago. Fnatic sits 7th at 3-5 (9-11 games), needing a victory to chase a top-six playoffs spot after sweeping Team Heretics 2-0 last match but stumbling against elites like Karmine Corp and Natus Vincere recently. Vitality's stable roster—Naak Nako, Lyncas, Humanoid, Carzzy, Fleshy—dominates on patch 26.6 meta favoring macro plays, while Fnatic's Empyros, Razork, Vladi, Upset, and Trymbi aim to split maps via Upset's hyper-carry potential in a must-win scenario.

title: Indian Premier League: Mumbai Indians vs Lucknow Super Giants
description:

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mumbai Indians and Lucknow Super Giants face a do-or-die IPL clash at Wankhede Stadium, both languishing at the bottom with slim playoff hopes—MI ninth with two wins from nine, LSG tenth on four points from eight. MI won the toss and elected to bowl first, with Suryakumar Yadav captaining due to Hardik Pandya's illness, while Rohit Sharma returns from hamstring injury as an impact sub alongside Jasprit Bumrah's pace threat. Recent MI losses, like to CSK, underscore their batting woes, but Bumrah's form and home momentum could shift trader consensus in this high-stakes T20 encounter.
